name: The Level Ground
pitch: On your terraces a law caps every layer at the ordinary for everyone, and two centuries of bunds push your laid arts to twice what the art lint allows, so the realm's finest arrives as one more farmer and drowns in small channels.

new.name: Level Ground
new.effect: A Ground Law: on this ground L2, L3 and L5 count at most 40, 40 and 10, for both sides.
new.second_home: any sect's gate, any boss arena

new.name: Deep Mud
new.effect: A Ground Law: cooldown_min is 3 s on this ground, for both sides.

new.name: Dry Season
new.effect: A Ground Law: regen_base is 0 on this ground, for both sides.
new.second_home: NPC grounds, dead places in secret realms

new.name: Taken Ground
new.effect: A ground holds one formation: the other side's L4 counts at most 20.

new.name: Old Bund
new.effect: +0.05 to the coefficient of arts with the formation source tag per 10 years the formation has stood, to +1.0.
new.second_home: any standing formation, any sect's home array

new.name: Standing Water
new.effect: A formation's timer runs from the day it was laid: its arts first fire at the first pulse.

new.name: Deep Bund
new.effect: L4 points past the cap add +0.01 each to formation arts' coefficient.

new.name: Field Walls
new.effect: While your formation stands, formation_power_pct also counts as ward strength and efficiency.

new.name: Known Ground
new.effect: +25 points per ground tag at a place where you have lived a full cycle of seasons.

new.name: Untended Field
new.effect: Leave the ground for 5 years, or miss upkeep, and Old Bund resets to 0.

new.name: Ground Law
new.effect: A laid formation carries one law moving listed Combat keys for one fight, for both sides. Closes: nothing in a blind fight, and the years reset if you leave.

new.name: Ground Law
new.effect: Combat rule 12 and a list of movable keys in Formations. Serves gate arrays, boss arenas, secret realms and tribulation preparation.

new.name: Thousand-Furrow Killing Array
new.effect: An offensive formation: L4 12 points a level, and the source of the arts with the formation tag.

new.name: Level Ground Array
new.effect: Carries the Level Ground law.

new.name: New Rice Wine
new.effect: +30 L4, foreseen only, brewed from your own field.

new.name: Paddy Keeper's Canon
new.effect: Main, Thiên giai, Earth and Water. Ditch in four forms and Rising Water, all laid, seals Bund and Channel.

new.name: Rising Water
new.effect: Qi hit, formation source, c_art 2.45, cost 0.08, 3 s. Dead without the array.

new.name: Ditch
new.effect: One art in four forms, each slotted on its own: body or qi, water or earth. Formation source, c_art 1.75, cost 0.03, 3 s. Dead without the array.

new.name: Hoe Stroke
new.effect: Body hit, c_art 2.45, cost 0.08, 3 s. The one art that works in a blind fight.

new.name: Walk Home
new.effect: Escape art, cost 0.10, 5 s, guarded on own health below 30 %.

new.name: Bund and Channel
new.effect: Theme formations and land, Earth, outer, sealed by a technique, size 10. Notables Known Ground and Deep Bund, capability Field Walls.

new.name: Array, Field branch
new.effect: Old Bund, Standing Water, Untended Field and Hoe Stroke, ending in Ground Law.

questions: Rule 12 says a blind fight holds only the loadout, so a standing formation is down even at home. Is that the intent?

Does a Flat base count against the art lint? Old Bund is worth far more on a cheap art, which turned the great sluice into five small channels. The answer decides this build: the Bunds are half its engine.
Heavenly Tribulation rule 5 counts a laid formation. Does a Ground Law bind a tribulation boss?
Open Question 4 matters most here: this build is only as good as what it can see before the fight.
